Name: CharlieBarley Memory Portraits
Author: daleonar
Description:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@CharlieBarley/featured]CharlieBarley[/url] uploaded a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xH11zZkOV-s&t=625s]video[/url] of the results of trying to draw 10 Stardew Valley characters from memory. I created pixel versions of those drawings and used those to replace the portraits of those characters.

Characters Included:
Wizard
Mr. Qi
Henchman
Birdie
Sandy
Jas
Leo
George
Harvey
Gus

This will replace all of the portraits for the characters including any unique portraits that are used to display any emotions.

Downloads.Description: Contains manifest JSON, content JSON, and png assests.
